name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
regular=Decimal('130')
overtime=Decimal('9')
rate=Decimal('23.1')
mult=Decimal('1.73')
withholding=Decimal('0.2137')
deduction=Decimal('138')
gross=regular*rate + overtime*rate*mult
net=gross*(1-withholding)-deduction
print(gross, gross.quantize(Decimal('.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
print(net, net.quantize(Decimal('.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
PY"}
